name: demli
description: Premium, private, realtime desktop communication app for friend groups

scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-caddyfile.mjs && node scripts/check-brand-icons.mjs && node scripts/check-env-examples.mjs && node scripts/check-deploy-scripts.mjs

//overrides: Transitive security patches. Every entry here is a package we do NOT depend on
directly — the fix has to be forced from the root because the direct dependent
(fastify, expo, tailwind) has not released a version that asks for it yet.
Each override is a CARET range inside the major the tree already resolved, not the
advisory's bare `>=`: `>=3.1.4` for fast-uri silently installed 4.1.2, and `>=11.1.1`
for uuid installed 14.0.1 — an override is not the place to discover a major bump.
uuid is the one exception: no 7.x fix exists, so 11.x is the smallest patched major.
Each entry can be deleted the day the parent catches up. Re-check with `pnpm audit --prod`.
brace-expansion is scoped to @5 on purpose: only 5.0.7 is reachable from a production
dependency, and forcing the 1.x/2.x copies (dev tooling, minimatch@3) up two majors
would be a breaking change bought for nothing.
Deliberately absent: drizzle-orm (<0.45.2, SQL injection). That is 0.36 -> 0.45,
a real migration across packages/db, not an override — tracked separately.
